import math
def hzc2(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='B' and n['pixels']==4:
            b=n['boundary']; out.append(((min(p[0] for p in b)+max(p[0] for p in b))/2.0,(min(p[1] for p in b)+max(p[1] for p in b))/2.0))
    return out
def st(fr):
    ps,hz,bar=snap(fr); hz=hzc2(fr)
    rows=[]
    for p in ps:
        sz=2 if p[1]==4 else (3 if p[1]==9 else 4)
        cy,cx=p[2]+(sz-1)/2.0,p[3]+(sz-1)/2.0
        rows.append((p[0],round(cy),round(cx),[round(math.hypot(h[0]-cy,h[1]-cx),1) for h in hz]))
    return rows,[ (round(h[0],1),round(h[1],1)) for h in hz],bar
def play(clicks):
    for (rr,cc) in clicks:
        ps0,hz0,b0=snap(current_frame)
        r=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':rr,'col':cc}])
        ps1,hz1,b1=snap(current_frame)
        e0,e1=equiv(ps0),equiv(ps1)
        print((rr,cc),'eq',e0,'->',e1,'done',r.get('level_completed'),'over',r.get('game_over'))
        if e1<e0:
            action([{'action':'UNDO'}]); print('  LOST->undone; was',st(history[-1].frame) if history else '')
            return False
        print('  ',st(current_frame))
        if r.get('level_completed') or r.get('game_over'): return None
    return True

            b=n['boundary']; out.append(((min(p[0] for p in b)+max(p[0] for p in b))/2.0,(min(p[1] for p in b)+max(p[1] for p in b))/2.0))

def pc(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('M','p','Y') and n['pixels'] in (4,9,16):
            b=n['boundary']; r0,c0=min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b); sz=2 if n['pixels']==4 else (3 if n['pixels']==9 else 4)
            out.append((n['color'],r0+(sz-1)/2.0,c0+(sz-1)/2.0))
    return out
def draft(hi,dr,dc):
    H=hzlist(current_frame); h=H[hi]; P=pc(current_frame)
    nd=min(math.hypot(p[1]-h[0],p[2]-h[1]) for p in P)
    best=None
    for k in (10,9,8,7,6):
        rr=int(round(h[0]+dr*k)); cc=int(round(h[1]+dc*k))
        if not (11<=rr<=61 and 1<=cc<=62): continue
        if k>=nd: continue
        if min(math.hypot(p[1]-rr,p[2]-cc) for p in P)<=8.5: continue
        best=(rr,cc,k); break
    if best is None: print('no draft for',hi,(dr,dc),'nd',round(nd,1)); return False

    H2=hzlist(current_frame); P2=pc(current_frame)

    return True
